name: software-factory
description: Local Software Factory core skeleton (TASK-001) with durable SQLite persistence (TASK-002) and a real worker runner (TASK-003)

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js demo
scripts.demo:persistent: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js demo:persistent
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.worker:doctor: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js worker doctor
scripts.smoke:claude-worker: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js worker smoke claude
scripts.smoke:codex-worker: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/main.js worker smoke codex
scripts.smoke:workers: npm run smoke:claude-worker && npm run smoke:codex-worker
